json.title: Endless Coastline
json.logline: A nostalgic journey along a golden summer coastline where time feels suspended forever.

palette: soft sage green in distant foliage
character_rules: one protagonist appears in every scene with the same face, hair length and build
wardrobe is identical from the first scene to the last
the face stays readable in at least three-quarter profile
style_bible.lighting: cinematic low-angle golden-hour light with gentle halation and soft falloff
style_bible.medium: loose gouache painting with visible brush strokes and softly blended colour

events.visual: A quiet close-up of a young woman leaning against a vintage car window.
The soft gouache textures bloom outwards revealing a coastal highway.
Golden coastal air rolls past as her dark hair lifts in the sea breeze.
Sun flares over the horizon, illuminating her face in intense warm rose light.
The camera pulls back to reveal a majestic endless ocean vista under golden sunset.
A collage of summer memories flashes softly across the screen.
The scene calms to a wide view of her looking out at the peaceful sea.
The final golden brushstrokes softly fade into quiet twilight tones.

scenes.camera_note: Slow gentle push toward the subject's face reflecting golden light.
scenes.action: A young woman in an olive green jacket gazes thoughtfully out of a car window.
scenes.setting: Interior of a vintage car parked along an overcast coastal road, painted in loose gouache.

scenes.camera_note: Subtle dimensional shift expanding the painterly horizon.
scenes.action: The coastline stretches out into warm sun-bleached terracotta cliffs behind her.
scenes.setting: An elevated coastal overlook with distant foliage in soft sage green under sunset light.

scenes.camera_note: Upward tilt capturing hair motion and glowing sky.
scenes.action: Warm coastal wind catches the young woman's dark brown hair against glowing amber sunlight.
scenes.setting: A windy coastal ridge overlooking sparkling ocean water in gouache brushwork.

scenes.camera_note: Rapid emotional push towards her expression right before the drop.
scenes.action: Golden hour light creates a brilliant halo around her profile.
scenes.setting: Extreme close-up of the young woman bathed in intense warm rose sunset glow.

scenes.camera_note: Sweeping cinematic pull-out expanding to an immense epic view.
scenes.action: The young woman stands on an open cliff edge overlooking a vast endless glowing ocean.
scenes.setting: Panoramic ocean cliffside bathed in breathtaking golden amber light and milky cream highlights.

scenes.camera_note: Floating dreamlike drift across layered painterly snapshots.
scenes.action: Layered gouache painting fragments display summer moments along the seashore.
scenes.setting: Artistic multi-panel collage of sea waves, glowing horizons, and her silhouette.

scenes.camera_note: Slow retreat allowing the scene to softly rest.
scenes.action: The young woman sits peacefully on a wooden bench watching the sunset calm down.
scenes.setting: A serene coastal trail in deep blue-violet shadow with soft amber highlights on the water.
